hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: target_directory
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 1st level prefix after bucket_s3_name Ex: imaging_aric

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: internal_visit_name
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
Ex: Visit1 or Visit2...etc.
should match the visit being pulled from s3 uri

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# 0) guard for “imaging*” case "${target_directory:-}" in imaging*) ;; *) echo "Error: target_directory must start with 'imaging'" >&2 exit 1 ;; esac
# 1) assume role (using aws CLI --query to avoid grep hacks) creds=$(aws sts assume-role \ --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3" \ --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" \ --output json)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$( jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId <<<"$creds") export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey <<<"$creds") export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$( jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken <<<"$creds")
# 2) prep dirs tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d) mkdir -p "$internal_visit_name"
# 3) pull all XML in one go into tmp_dir aws s3 cp "${visit_s3_uri}" \ "$tmp_dir" \ --recursive \ --exclude "*" \ --include "*.xml" \ --no-progress
# 4) flatten into your target find "$tmp_dir" -type f -name '*.xml' -exec mv -t "$internal_visit_name" -- {} +
# 5) cleanup temp rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
# 6) (optionally) unset creds if you’re finished with AWS unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
# 7) upload flattened back to S3 aws s3 cp "$internal_visit_name" \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${target_directory}/rawData/$internal_visit_name" \ --recursive \ --no-progress
